modelingNotes: Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT): Concourses D and E — procedural, CC0-1.0.

Concourse D (way/1347417024), the international pier east of The Plaza: a 10.5 m older pier, then the taller gate hall that runs out to its half-round east end, its roof rolling down to the walls along every edge. Concourse E (way/1355079414), the regional concourse: a connector angling north-east from The Plaza through two round nodes to a hub, then a long pier north and an arm east, lined with ground-boarding gates. E is low, white and two storeys (Commons "CLT Concourse E"; the 2025 apron photos by ZLEA); its hub carries a glazed drum, and the connector's two nodes are small drums too, on the round bulges OSM maps there.

Heights (D 10.5 m and 16 m with the roll starting at 13.8 m; E 6.5 m; the drums 10-11 m) and the roof forms were checked against renders of Mapbox's 3D buildings (tileset mapbox.mapbox-3dbuildings-v1), used only as a visual reference: the geometry is OSM's outlines and our own modelling.
Site frame and helpers: see clt-terminal.ts.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "clt-concourses-d-e", model "clt-concourses-d-e"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/c3921f733df14b41e1f6d15853cce7b343886f17/generators/clt-concourses-d-e.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
